configuration.aircraft: Synthetic tricycle aircraft, no Stik measurements.
configuration.motor: Invented engine; rotation convention not applicable.
configuration.propeller: No physical propeller; RPM values invented.
configuration.gear: Tricycle; nose-load channel is an invented sensor reading.
configuration.controls: Throttle command 0=idle, 1=full; other controls held neutral in invented series.
configuration.restraint: None in invented series; no recommended field procedure.
configuration.heading_frame: Unwrapped ground heading, positive right viewed from above; 179 to 183 degrees crosses the wrapped branch.
configuration.position_reference: Lateral position of main gear midpoint, positive right of initial heading; nose tire clearance above local surface.
configuration.synchronization: Invented common clock; t bounds include synchronization and sample selection errors.

split_plan: Synthetic split exercises bookkeeping only. Real trials must be assigned before fitting, with different trial and source identities.
